# ledger_users (Data Source)

Lists Ledger users, in identifier order, disabled ones included unless filtered. User routes need an API token with the `users:read` and `users:write` grants. Creating or promoting an administrator, re-enabling a disabled administrator, and changing the root (first) account need the **root token** of the root account; any other token is refused with `root_token_required`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Enabled administrators.
data "ledger_users" "admins" {
  roles    = ["administrator"]
  disabled = false
}

output "admin_usernames" {
  value = [for u in data.ledger_users.admins.items : u.username]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Only disabled (`true`) or only enabled (`false`) users. Both are listed when unset.
- `roles` (List of String) Only users with one of these roles (`administrator`, `read-only`).
- `username_prefix` (String) Only users whose username starts with this text.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is disabled.
- `disabled_at` (String) When it was disabled (RFC 3339, UTC), or null.
- `display_name` (String) The display name, or null.
- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier.
- `role` (String) `administrator` or `read-only`.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `username` (String) The sign-in name.
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version.
